difficulty_reason: Unobstructedness versus the smooth locus: descends the question along the flat Cohen ring Lambda, then verifies the nontrivial equality of the deformation category with the fibre category of the stack - Y is a scheme over Artinian base by the codimension-1 criterion, relative dimension is preserved on fibres by definition, and properness with finite presentation transfers via the deformation-property lemma. Retained author proof at lines 1636-1678.
